scope: Implementation and cost only on previously used boards. M10000, N1500, 5 pp NI margin and all streams are fixed before this pilot. No outcome-dependent setting choice.
calibration_pool_rule: Unique source-row union of the prior H1x banks, sorted by source row. It is disjoint from the original clues banks. For each pilot seed0..5 draw10000 rows without replacement using RNG20284000+s.
noise_draw_rule: Independent Bernoulli(.01) flips followed by uniform int8 offsets1..8. Calibration draws arrays(10000,2), then offsets of the same shape; cells use integers0..80. Training draws81flips then81offsets per row, after all current masks finalize.
budget: Six old training banks and six independent calibration draws only; no solver inference and no extension.
